c: p:kono subarashii sekai ni syukufuku o
d:
this is my first time doing a translation, so I was experi-
menting with fonts as I went along. the other available
english translation is bad and none of the sound effects are
translated. I hope by now you see how much they elevate the
experience. I know a little chinese so I was able to enjoy the
chinese version, but tbh it's also not very good.

yunyun is such a likeable character. she deserves a good
translation. I tried to make the dude seem like a good natured
caring guy, even if he is a pervert. I hope you liked it.
